family_assessments.assessment: Some adapters enforce typed envelope fields; others coerce values or omit action/case binding. Native kernels and unavailable dependencies were not built or used. An injected malformed outcome exposes an adapter boundary without proving the canonical host produces it.

All checker bodies and preamble were read. They decide restricted finite predicates over declared data and axioms. PASS may validate a negative, obstruction or out-of-scope certificate rather than the positive domain claim. The 1033 supplied cases are regression observations; independently authored controls expose both false acceptance relative to broader prose and deliberately incomplete certificate policies.

Exact graph parity, finite involution cancellation, rational matrix identities and finite algebra checks have useful conditional content. Input completeness, chosen grammar, orientation, normalization, manifold validity and source interpretation remain distinct obligations. A finite calculation is not a derivation of a physical law.

family_assessments.family: Evidence, replay, budgets and sandbox boundaries
family_assessments.assessment: Digests bind only encoded fields; a locally recomputed head is not an externally authenticated root. In-process restrictions and copied subprocess packages are not OS isolation. Scripted fixture success and supplied coverage strings are not empirical learning or provider execution evidence. Source bodies were read without launching models, providers, historical migrations or broad native builds.

All 101 stage notes were read literally. The compendium explicitly withholds derivation/authority claims, separates wire syntax from semantic obligations, and requires future typed transports and independent checkers. Linked external/sealed sources were not followed. Its local predicates must still be constrained by the actual checker findings in this report.

138 schema-specific parsed assessments remain full_source_read=false. Byte pins, indices, dimensions, references and exact bounded finite gauge enumeration were evaluated where appropriate. Most expected result fields remain supplied ground truth. One catalog fixture pin is stale; no original artifact was repaired.

claims.claim: On a declared finite signed graph, a vertex Z2 gauge satisfying every edge or an odd closed edge walk provides an exact complementary witness. This is fixed-graph/fixed-diagonal-grammar mathematics, not a Hamiltonian or sign-problem derivation.
claims.limits: 729 finite graphs and one continuation chain independently tested; theorem argument is the parity sum/BFS forest invariant.

claims.claim: An explicit finite fixed-point-free weight-preserving sign-reversing involution cancels its subset exactly; if every remaining signed contribution is nonnegative, the total equals a nonnegative survivor sum.
claims.limits: Conditional on complete host-supplied sector list and exact weights. No Hamiltonian derivation or general sign-freedom certificate.

findings.claim: Exact native adapter coerces string false to True for positive-definite, boundary-closed and closure predicates; rank 1.9 becomes 1, and string success=false is truthy. Injected malformed envelopes demonstrate missing strict output schema/action binding; this does not show canonical native code emits them.

Plain-text representation fails round-trip equality for valid TurnView names containing equals/colon, embedded newlines and surrounding whitespace. It also parses empty text as zero metrics. Exact information equivalence needs a stricter admitted syntax or escaping.
Glyph JSON parsing int-coerces a Boolean round and fractional metric before strict TurnView validation, accepting true as 1 and 1.9 as 1.

OESOS receipt is mutable, accepts an unverified broken chain and excludes metadata from its digest. Distinct metadata can share a receipt digest, and event mutation leaves a stale digest. Hashing selected fields is not immutable authenticated evidence.

findings.claim: Atom-count budget does not bound structural quantifier evaluation;64 outer branches with empty inner domain PASS at budget0 and make65 evaluator calls.
The composed-bound policy refuses a valid weaker upper bound: actual error1 and proven step bound1 imply bound2, but <=sum check returns R033_BOUND_NOT_COMPOSED.

Reachable-final plus no deadlock does not guarantee termination or a route to final from every reachable state. A separate closed live trap branch PASSes. This is a limit of the explicit predicate, not a contradiction of its existential-end clause.
No unit normalization is enforced for blind joint weights: row2 on a1x1 carrier passes with every table totaling4. Probability-language use needs an explicit normalized-input assumption.
Closed surface input claim is not enforced. Two tetrahedral sphere boundaries sharing one vertex pass all edge-incidence/angle/action checks despite a disconnected vertex link.
Universal edge-derived closure statement fails for allowed ordering/connectors. An actual S3 edge assignment with correctly recomputed faces refuses solely on nonidentity closure.
Derived record digests bind only id/value, not operation or input lineage; independent sum/product derivations share a digest. Historical immutability requires an external root/custody policy.
Principal self-handoff narrowing is ignored, unlike the general last-handoff prose. A read-only self-handoff followed by write task passes.
Unmapped target relation can silently alias a source relation via rename fallback. A typed mapR->S does not bind target-onlyR, yet equivalence passes by evaluating sourceR.
An initially empty-clause CNF cannot carry the natural zero-step refutation: checker refuses it as flag-without-proof. This is certificate incompleteness rather than unsound acceptance.
Chebyshev inequality is sufficient, not necessary for actual coverage; always-full[0,1] interval at n1,h1 is refused for alpha1/10 despite coverage1.
An explicitly OPEN claim disappears from frontier once any declared test link exists, even though test adequacy/results are not checked.
Missing fence-audit fields default clean even with a declared violation; no host audit recomputation occurs. Packet still cannot promote from permanent quarantine.
Malformed assertion_flags=null raises AttributeError outside typed refusal handling.
Exported encoder accepts NaN and is deterministic Python JSON, not strict RFC8785 canonical JSON as claimed.
Self-contained count/head header can be rewritten with a shortened valid prefix and new id; chain verifies without external head binding.
Unsafe-id hashed filename aliases the literal safe hex-digest id, and load does not bind requested id to header id.
Controller accepts a replay-valid CEC extension whose packet parent differs from the controller problem argument. It never binds the candidate packet to that requested problem.
